Context: 4. Deputation (Duty) Allowance

During such deputation, the ad hoc promotion in the parent cadre and consequent pay which he would have been entitled to, had he continued on such ad hoc post in the parent cadre, will be notionally continued for the purpose of fixation of his pay on repatriation from deputation. On repatriation, the officer will revert back to the post which he would have held had he continued in the parent cadre without proceeding on such deputation.
